Per-graph benchmark_model rows (latency + delegate coverage on random inputs; every gather index is clamped in-graph so the tool cannot fault); no on-device functional run exists — functional parity is Mac-only on the same files (FINDINGS §8). `artifact` is the file name the bench driver used on the phone; codec_fp16_T128_g2.tflite = the file shipped as codec_decoder_fp16_T128.tflite (built_from codec/codec_decoder_fp16_T128_g2.tflite); the mapping to the published file is build_manifest.json built_from + FINDINGS ('S26 clean legs ... 2-signature slow graphs = the shipped files', §6 'shipped files') and the card's Performance table, which quotes these legs; the device copy's bytes were not digested in the log, so artifact_sha256 is absent (#167(e) shape). One call decodes 128 frames = 5.94 s of 44.1 kHz audio, so the GPU's 923 ms per call is an RTF of about 0.16 for the codec stage alone and the CPU's 3664 ms about 0.62. The fp32 build of the same graph (codec_fp32_T128_g2.tflite, not published) delegates 971/971 nodes in 1 partition at 924.22 ms avg with a 1461.86 MB footprint (s26_codec3_bench.log lines 1-6) — the fp16 file's CPU remainder (DEQUANTIZE of the fp16 weights + the codebook EMBEDDING_LOOKUP) costs no time, only memory. The earlier attention build (codec_fp16_T128 v1, not published) delegated 422/1246 nodes at 1016 ms (s26_codec_fp16_T128_gpu.log lines 22-42, 172, 190: BROADCAST_TO / rank-5 CONCATENATION and RESHAPE refused) — staged for the matrix, not a row. Dates: the legs carry no per-run stamp; 2026-09-28 is the session date (FINDINGS/NOTES header, the g2 full log's own epoch 1790547879 = 2026-09-28 07:24 JST, out/ mtimes 06:59-07:27 JST, all before the 09:12 JST Hub upload). Hand-built from the logs (build script in the session scratchpad); model-level facts only, no op row derives from this record (the op-level lines are staged separately for the matrix).
